name: ctxgate
description: A sufficient local repository context engine, evaluated against explicit baselines.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs eval/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests eval/tests eval/scripts eval/labels examples package.json tsconfig.json .github/workflows
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests eval/tests eval/scripts eval/labels examples package.json tsconfig.json .github/workflows
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
